import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import xgboost as xgb
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

np.random.seed(42)

input_dir = "./input"
test_data_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
train_data_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
sample_submission_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"
submission_dir = "./submission"
submission_file = f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv"

os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)
template_cols = sample_submission.columns.tolist()

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_data_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_data_path)

features = [col for col in train_df.columns if col not in ["id", "target"]]

categorical_to_drop = ["f_27", "f_29", "f_30"]
for col in categorical_to_drop:
    if col in features:
        features.remove(col)

numerical_features = [col for col in features]
print(f"Using {len(numerical_features)} features: {numerical_features}")

# Column alignment validation
missing_in_test = set(numerical_features) - set(test_df.columns)
if missing_in_test:
    print(f"WARNING: Missing columns in test set: {missing_in_test}")

redundant_in_train = set(test_df.columns) - set(numerical_features)
if redundant_in_train:
    print(f"WARNING: Redundant columns in train that not in test: {redundant_in_train}")

train_set = train_df[numerical_features].copy()
test_set = test_df[numerical_features].copy()

# Median imputation before standardization
median_values = train_set.median()
train_imputed = train_set.fillna(median_values)
test_imputed = test_set.fillna(median_values)

mean = train_imputed.mean()
std = train_imputed.std().replace(0, 1)
train_normalized = (train_imputed - mean) / std.values
test_normalized = (test_imputed - mean) / std.values

X_train = train_normalized.values.astype(np.float32)
y_train = train_df["target"].values.astype(np.float64)
X_test = test_normalized.values.astype(np.float32)

X_train_val, X_test_val, y_train_val, y_test_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
    objective="binary:logistic",
    n_estimators=800,
    max_depth=6,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    min_child_weight=2,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    gamma=0.1,
    reg_alpha=0.1,
    reg_lambda=1,
    eval_metric="auc",
    n_jobs=-1,
    tree_method="hist",
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
)
model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)

val_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test_val)[:, 1]
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_test_val, val_predictions)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC Score: {round(validation_auc, 4)}")

test_predictions = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_predictions = np.clip(test_predictions, 0.0, 1.0)

submission_df = sample_submission.copy()
submission_df["target"] = test_predictions

submission_df.to_csv(submission_file, index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to {submission_file}")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(test_predictions)}")
print(f"Final Training Set Size: {len(train_df)}")
print(f"Validation Set Size: {len(X_test_val)}")
print(f"Test Set Size: {len(X_test)}")
